messages:
Maya: Quick async check — prepping canary toggle for model v13.1. Plan: start NA 1% -> 10% over 48h, EU 0% -> 5% over 48h. Need guardrails (latency, error-rate, quality), a rollback sim, and owner for PR + rollout. CC @Sasha @Oliver :eyes:
Sasha: SGTM. What's the feature flag key and where does the routing layer read it from? Also do we pin sessions during the canary?
Tony: I can wire dashboards. Which metrics to surface? token latency p50/p95, API error rate, hallucination rate from safety evals?
Oliver: Suggested gates: error rate > 0.8% absolute increase over baseline -> auto-cut; p95 latency +40% -> cut; quality regression (avg eval pass rate drop > 2.5 percentage points) -> cut. Also require 2 consecutive 15m windows failing to trigger auto-cut.
Maya: Flag key: features.model_v13_1_canary. Routing reads from feature-service (env REDWOOD_FLAGS) — we use cookie-based session pinning by default for % slices, unless `force_new` enabled. For this rollout I propose session pinning = true.
Tony: I'll add a per-route dashboard: /models/v13.1/requests with p50/p95 token time, 5xx %, and sample prompt/response stream. Will keep 1h retention of raw traces for first 24h.
Sasha: PR needed: infra/flags#1123 — can someone add a small test that verifies the flag propagates to the router? Also ping on code review.
Maya: Creating PR now. Deploy-bot schedule: deploy plan queued. Command: `deployctl plan --flag features.model_v13_1_canary --env prod`
deploy-bot: deployctl: plan created by Maya, id=plan-2026-02-12-09. Estimated rollout window: 2026-02-13 01:00 UTC -> 48h ramp.
Tony: If we want a rollback sim, we should rehearse `featurectl rollback` path. Example: `featurectl set features.model_v13_1_canary 0 --sim` will run the evaluation hooks and validate downstream drain. Can we run that in staging first?
Maya: Agreed. I'll run the sim against the staging traffic slice and post logs.
Oliver: One more ask: add a short-circuit fallback to model_v12.x in the routing policy if any region loses >25% capacity to prevent capacity-induced errors.
Sasha: Also add log marker `CANARY=v13.1` at router ingress so we can filter traces quickly.
Maya: Added YAML config snippet in the PR description:
```
flag: features.model_v13_1_canary
scopes:
  - region: NA
    start_percent: 1
    end_percent: 10
    duration: 48h
  - region: EU
    start_percent: 0
    end_percent: 5
    duration: 48h
session_pinning: true
auto_cut_rules:
  error_rate_delta: 0.008
  latency_p95_delta: 0.40
  quality_drop_pp: 2.5
```
Maya: PR: https://repo.redwood.ai/infra/flags/pull/1123 (assigning Sasha for review, Tony for dashboards)
Tony: Will review infra changes + add grafana panels, ETA 2 hours.
Sasha: Reviewing now. Quick note: make sure qa-bot runs the prompt-set regression check after each percent bump.
qa-bot: scheduled: regression-eval (promptset: canary-critical-50) at each ramp step. Will post summary to thread.
Maya: Taking ownership of the rollout runbook and rollback drill. I'll post the cutover checklist and the exact UTC times after PR merges.
Oliver: I'll be on-call the first 12h of ramp. If auto-cut triggers, I'll verify logs and approve a manual rollback iff the sim shows drain issues.
Sasha: Thanks all — small follow-ups: retention for canary traces = 72h, capture 1000 sample responses/hour for manual QA.
Maya: Noted. Anything else? Otherwise I'll merge PR once Sasha approves and kick the plan. :thumbsup:
